title: Megawatt
tagline: Eight empty computer halls, two busy crews and a 500-megawatt campus to switch on.
blurb: Eight empty computer halls, two busy crews and a 500-megawatt campus to switch on. Lay the cable, run the cooling pipe, ride out the grid maintenance days and light every rack, hall by hall, until the whole campus glows and the crew get their thank-you. Then start a fresh campus and beat your best!
controls: Q / A / O / P or cursor keys
Build (hold while moving to lay a run)
Quit to title (in pause, press twice)

review.verdict: Eight halls, one happy ending: a current affair for planners, if still a power cut for blasters.
